faqs.a:
Fees submitted to the city at the time of application for a license or permit are
               not refundable once the application has been accepted by the city clerk. Additionally,
               in the event a license is suspended or revoked, as provided in this article, no part
               of the fees paid therefor shall be returned to the holder.
(
Ord. No. 4670
, § 1, 12-17-2018)
State Law reference—
Fees, C.R.S. § 44-3-601.
